name: Boai NKY Medical Holdings Ltd.
summary: Boai NKY Medical Holdings Ltd. engages in the fine chemical and precision medicine businesses in China and internationally. The company produces and sells polyvinyl pyrrolidone (PVP) series products, vinyl methyl ether/maleic anhydride copolymer (PVM/MA, Euroster) copolymer, and oral care products; and medical technology services, such as early tumor screening, molecular diagnostics, and precision medicine.
